description: Hand refers to things like poker hands, except here it is with dice rather than cards.
REROLLs are used to roll selected dice again.
BONES are the basic score units in the game.
MULT is short for multiplier.
the result of BONES x MULT

text: Choose challenges to make the game harder.

Each challenge gives a set amount of challenge points.

Unlock more challenges by winning with enough challenge points.

The total score is increased by 15% for every 5 challenge points.

The game continues past level 25.

Yellow skulls, extra rerolls and hands are not given past level 25.

Some statistics and records are not tracked.
A short challenge that changes every day.
Completed! Come back next day for a new challenge.

A new daily challenge arrives every day at ?.

The game ends at level 10. You start with eight skulls in your deck and all hand upgrades are locked to level 2.

Some statistics and records are not tracked.

text:
- Rerolling rolls the selected dice.
- Initial rolls do not roll the middle die.
- Start every level with one less reroll.

- Rerolling rolls the selected dice.
- Exactly two dice can be rerolled at a time.
- Start every level with one more reroll.

- Rerolls roll all the dice.
- Start every level with one more reroll.

- Rerolling rolls the selected dice.
- Every die can be rerolled only once per hand.
- Start every level with two more rerolls.

- Rerolling rolls the selected dice.
- Rerolling dice never increases their value.
- Start every level with one less reroll.

- Rerolling increments the number of the selected die up by 1.
- Rerolling a die with the number 6 turns it into 1.
- Only one die can be rerolled at a time.

- Rerolling turns the selected die upside down.
- Only one die can be rerolled at a time.

- Rerolling a die makes it swap its number with the number of the die to its right.
- Rerolling the last die makes it swap its number with the first die.
- Start the game with all hands upgraded once.
